name: Classic geometric control map v1
content: Build a complete geometric control map for the authoritative current Classic chess position. Include every White and Black piece exactly once, including pieces with no controlled squares. This is geometry only: do not evaluate the position, identify threats, propose moves, calculate variations or exchanges. Pawn controls are the two forward diagonals within the board (White towards higher ranks, Black towards lower ranks), regardless of occupancy, never forward movement squares or a special en-passant move. Knights jump by (1,2)/(2,1). Kings control adjacent squares irrespective of attacks on the king; castling is not a control. Bishops, rooks and queens control every square along their permitted rays up to and INCLUDING the first occupied square, then stop. Include squares occupied by friendly pieces. Pins, checks and king safety never remove geometric controls. Do not include a piece’s own square. Use the actual inventory, board and blockers, not remembered starting positions. Each id is color w/b + uppercase standard piece letter K,Q,R,B,N,P + underscore + its square, e.g. bN_f6. Use lowercase algebraic squares a1 through h8. Sort pieces by id and controls lexicographically; no duplicates. After any configured reasoning, the entire final answer must be exactly one JSON object without commentary: {"version":1,"pieces":[{"id":"bN_f6","square":"f6","controls":["d5","d7","e4","e8","g4","g8","h5","h7"]}]}. The example is abbreviated; your answer must contain ALL pieces of BOTH colors. Use precisely these fields and no others.
